text:
mikaela: FYI seeing a stream of leads from the product webinar that didn't land in RR. HubSpot webhook latency spiked ~45s and enrichment returned timeouts. At least 18 leads are marked "intake:unclaimed". Can we do a contained failover so SDRs still get handoffs?

devon: What if we add a short-circuit rule scoped to the webhook source (page_id=prod_webinar) so intake creates a partial lead and routes to an overflow queue? Keeps flow simple and limits blast radius.

alerts-bot: HubSpot webhook error rate up 9% last 5m. Avg latency 48s. Enrichment timeouts increased at 13:18:07.

olivia: OK with targeted fallback. We should suppress instant task creation in SF to avoid noise. If partial leads are created, we'll need an internal flag to reconcile later. Rollback criteria: duplicate lead creations > 1/min OR queued suppressed_tasks > 20 in 20m.

rex: Proposal: match source.page_id=="prod_webinar" AND enrichment_status==pending && pending_seconds>4 -> owner="Inbound Overflow Queue" AND intake_flags {"allow_partial":"true","suppress_task":"true","hs_fallback":"true"}. Add an internal note: "partial intake - enrichment pending".

jamie: I'll draft a short SDR message and a saved filter for hs_fallback=true so reps can triage. Also recommend a 10m digest cadence.

devon: Curl to patch config (staging first):
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://internal-config.redwood/api/v1/lead-routing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"round_robin": {"targeted_fallbacks": [{"match": {"source.page_id": "prod_webinar", "enrichment_status": "pending", "pending_seconds_gt": 4}, "owner": "Inbound Overflow Queue", "intake_flags": {"allow_partial": true, "suppress_task": true}, "hs_fallback": "true"}]}}'
```

mikaela: Action items: 1) devon -> deploy staging canary then prod if smoke passes. 2) rex -> add HubSpot internal note template and hs_fallback property. 3) olivia -> monitor SF dup/task metrics in #inbound-handoff and be ready to rollback. 4) jamie -> prepare SDR digest and saved filter. 5) mikaela -> open postmortem ticket after incident.

devon: Applying staging patch now. ETA 90s.

alerts-bot: Staging smoke passed. No dup anomalies in simulation.

devon: Rolling to prod. Patch applied at 13:21:11.

olivia: Watching metrics. Heartbeat in #inbound-handoff. I'll rollback if dup_rate > 1/min or suppressed_tasks > 20 in 20m.

alerts-bot: Config patch: lead-routing updated by devon at 13:21:11.

mikaela: Thanks. Keep fallback for 45m and then evaluate. Postmortem owners: mikaela, devon, rex. :white_check_mark:
